name: Colossus Lash
description: Whip a limb of qi as thick as a pillar across the opponent's guard and body.

name: Titan Snare
description: Throw down a giant loop of root that clamps the opponent at the waist and holds.

name: Greatsap Purge
description: Flush an ally's body with a flood of clean sap to carry out poison and taint.

name: Tall Bark
description: Raise a great sheet of bark qi in front of the user as tall as a tree.

name: Giantwood Volley
description: Hurl a heavy volley of trunk-sized stakes of qi at the opponent in a single flat line.

name: Colossus Crash
description: Bring the arm of the giant down on the opponent with the weight of a falling tree.

name: Elderbark Aegis
description: Wrap the user in many layers of ancient bark that grow thicker as they are struck.

name: Titanroot
description: Tear roots as big as trees up through the ground in a heaving arc around the user.

name: Elder Reckoning
description: Drive the colossus's full fist into the opponent in a single reckoning blow.

name: Colossal Rebirth
description: Pour a tree's age of life into an ally whose breath has just stopped and call it back at once.

name: Titan Veil
description: Spread a vast canopy of titan boughs over the user and allies that no strike pierces.

name: Fallen Trunk
description: Topple the giant on the foe in a stroke whose weight grows with every step it has fallen.

name: Colossus Felling
description: Fell the whole colossus across the field so that its fall levels everything up to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Creeping Ruin
description: Spread a dense mat of vines under the opponent that climbs the legs and chokes.

name: Seeding Wave
description: Throw a wave of seeds that sprout into thorned stalks within a breath.

name: Overgrow Mend
description: Let wild growth sweep over an ally's wounds and bind torn flesh back together.

name: Sporecloud Purge
description: Draw tainted blood out into a cloud of spores that carries the curse away.

name: Strangling Mass
description: Heap a huge mass of strangling vines over the opponent and crush it tight.

name: Briar Tempest
description: Whirl a hurricane of barbed briars around the user that rips through everything near.

name: Thornmass
description: Pile a bristling heap of thorns round the user that no blow reaches through.

name: Rootsurge Quake
description: Wrench a surge of roots through the ground so it buckles and splits underfoot.

name: Verdant Maw
description: Open a huge toothed jaw of vines in the ground that snaps shut on the opponent.

name: Wildbloom Rebirth
description: Burst a wild bloom over an ally whose breath has just stopped and force the heart to beat again.

name: Great Entangler
description: Wind a ceaseless tangle round every foe in reach until they can scarcely stir.

name: Overgrowth Crown
description: Set a crown of living thorns upon the opponent that drinks their qi as the school's closing seal.

name: Total Overgrowth
description: Loose the growth without limit so vine and thorn bury and crush all to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Seasonless Bough
description: Swing a bough that is always in leaf and always in fruit across the opponent.

name: Ageless Root
description: Bind the opponent with roots that have never rotted and cannot be cut.

name: Fruitful Mend
description: Hang fruit of life qi from the boughs for an ally to eat and be healed.

name: Perennial Purge
description: Cast out poison curse and backlash from an ally by the law of renewal.

name: Evergreen Reckoning
description: Bring down a great undying bough in a plain strike of unwithering weight.

name: Divine Canopy
description: Spread a canopy of divine leaves above allies that blocks falling force.

name: Sacred Rootweb
description: Join the roots of all allies in reach so strength flows between them as one body.

name: Heavenroot Pierce
description: Drive a root of divine qi up through guard and body in one straight line.

name: Undying Bloom
description: Open a bloom that heals every ally in reach again each time they are wounded.

name: Divine Rebirth
description: Pour the full law of renewal into a person at the edge of death within the short window.

name: Harvest Reckoning
description: Reap all who stand near the tree as a crop ripe for the cutting.

name: Law of Seasons
description: Pass through spring and summer and autumn and winter in one chain of strokes as the school's closing sequence.

name: Eternal Autumn
description: Bring a sudden autumn on all within reach so their life withers and falls to the ceiling of the tier.
